The Subtask Name: Search for Merriam-Webster Word of the Day entry
Step Range: 0-1
The Oracle: Locate the specific Merriam-Webster page for June 27, 2022
Evidence: Planner analyzes task and instructs WebSurfer to search; WebSurfer performs search and finds the DuckDuckGo result linking to the Merriam-Webster page.

The Subtask Name: Extract quote and attribution from the page
Step Range: 2-3
The Oracle: Identify the writer's name and the exact quoted text from the Word of the Day page
Evidence: Planner instructs WebSurfer to open the direct URL and extract details; WebSurfer opens the page and displays the quote attributed to Annie Levin.

The Subtask Name: Verify and finalize the answer
Step Range: 4-5
The Oracle: Confirm the writer's name and declare the task complete
Evidence: Planner analyzes the retrieved content, notes the attribution to Annie Levin, and concludes the task with the final answer.
